revision.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL PATIENT
Riverside Endoscopy Center (fictional) · Ambulatory endoscopy center
Procedure report

Patient: Test Patient Delta (synthetic)
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Patient status: Established patient of the practice.

Procedures performed: Esophagogastroduodenoscopy and colonoscopy, same session.

Indications: Iron deficiency anemia and intermittent dyspepsia.

Pre-procedure history and physical was reviewed and is unchanged. Sedation was provided by the anesthesia service.

UPPER ENDOSCOPY
The endoscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum. Mild erythema was seen in the gastric antrum. EGD with cold forceps biopsies of the gastric antrum was performed for Helicobacter pylori evaluation.

COLONOSCOPY
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum. The cecum was identified by the appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve. Bowel preparation was good (Boston Bowel Preparation Scale 7).
An 8 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon was removed with a cold snare and retrieved.
No other lesions were seen.

IMPRESSION
1. Antral erythema, biopsied.
2. Sigmoid polyp, removed by cold snare.

PLAN
Await pathology. Repeat colonoscopy interval to be set after pathology review.
